description: Focos de Queimadas is a series of datasets listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Indica a localização dos focos de queimadas e incêndios florestais identificados pelo satélite NOAA-15D. Os focos apresentados são os acumulados a partir de 01/01/2018 até a data de visualização (atual). Coverage: Brasil. The portal lists 130 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. Its tags are focos, foco, fogo, queimada, queimadas. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
